verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents a first-party Automations feature that schedules prompts to run at recurring times, with each run creating a chat through the normal completion pipeline. Its Computer component separately documents scheduled tasks with recurring examples such as "every weekday at 9" and "hourly", which is a true recurring schedule rather than a one-off action. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documented detail on schedule syntax, run history and failure handling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Automations let you schedule prompts to run automatically at recurring times.
Each run creates a chat and executes through the normal chat completion pipeline
Run a prompt on a schedule: "run the tests every weekday at 9", "summarize new files every Monday", "check the deploy hourly".
